title: Intracranial delivery of B7-H3-targeting CAR-T cells for recurrent glioblastoma: a phase 1 trial
summary:
Nature Medicine, Published online: 06 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41591-026-04557-6

In this phase 1 dose-escalation trial, intracranial delivery of B7-H3-targeting chimeric antigen receptor T cell therapy in patients with glioblastoma showed no dose-limiting toxicity signals and encouraging signals of clinical benefit.

title: Psilocybin-assisted therapy for treatment-resistant major depressive disorder in a public healthcare setting: a randomized controlled trial
summary:
Nature Medicine, Published online: 06 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41591-026-04541-0

In a publicly funded trial undertaken in the NHS in England, 60 adults with treatment-resistant major depression received psilocybin or placebo alongside standardized psychological support, with psilocybin showing significant improvements in depression symptoms, good tolerability and support for further research in public healthcare settings.

title: Dronabinol for nightmares in post-traumatic stress disorder: a randomized controlled trial
summary:
Nature Medicine, Published online: 05 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41591-026-04546-9

A randomized controlled trial found that dronabinol significantly reduced both the frequency and intensity of nightmares in patients with PTSD over 10 weeks, compared with placebo.

title: Divergent impacts of explainable AI for dermatological diagnosis on clinicians versus lay people
summary:
Nature Medicine, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41591-026-04553-w

Explainable AI, implemented for large language models that assist with dermatological diagnoses, has differing effects depending on whether the assistance is provided to primary care physicians or to lay users.

title: Non-invasive tests for the evaluation of liver fibrosis in MASLD
summary:
Nature Medicine, Published online: 03 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41591-026-04560-x

In the LITMUS imaging study, we assessed non-invasive alternatives to liver biopsy histopathology in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Elastography and elastography-based composite scores had sufficient diagnostic accuracy to replace liver biopsy histopathology in evaluating advanced fibrosis and cirrhosis, but no markers were accurate enough for diagnosing metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH).
